timing_contract.fit: first pilot half[64:448], centered reference+bandlimited derivative
timing_contract.interpolation: 129-tap Kaiser8 windowed sinc; normalized DC; symmetric64-sample halo
timing_contract.interpolation_noise_gain: finite interpolator not exactly allpass; whitenoise/occupied-band tests required
timing_contract.sinr: separate post-timing conditional estimate, not calibrated physical RF SINR

lo_contract.frequency_prior: nominal TX LO offset + original known-marker CFO
lo_contract.failure_action: return unchanged original IQ with explicit reason
limitations: requires correct repeated-frame timing and pilot CFO prior within30Hz of LO relation
requires stable additive tone over buffered capture; guards may miss payload-only drift
postprocessing quality is not a change to raw physical RF SINR
not independently validated across24 classes or low source SNR
